title: SERIESSUM rejects logicals with #VALUE!, zeroes fractional powers of negative x, and flushes subnormal powers
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, SERIESSUM(x, n, m, coefficients) rejects logical values with #VALUE! in every argument (including inside the coefficients array/range), treats an omitted or blank scalar x as 0, evaluates each power term x^(n + i*m) using POWER's kernel except substituting 0 (rather than #NUM!) when x < 0 and n + i*m is non-integral, flushes subnormal power terms to 0 before multiplying by the coefficient (even when the coefficient is 0), and multiplies each term in x87 PC64 before accumulating.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (row 201), jnt_aggregate_arrays (row 27), fn4_questions (16 rows qa129-qa148), f1_math.rs tests, and 2,952/2,952 full-bank SERIESSUM rows.
